title: Boundedness hypothesis, engineering consequence, and confinement-SDP relation for jet-tower convergence
html:
Remark. Boundedness hypothesis, engineering consequence, and confinement-SDP relation for jet-tower convergence

Remark on the hypothesis

The hypothesis |\Delta^{(n)}(\varrho)| \leq \Delta_{\max}(\varrho) — uniform boundedness of per-level binding across the brane tower — is the named conjecture conj:jet-tower-uniform-delta-max. This proposition therefore reduces the convergence question to a single boundedness statement: once \Delta^{(n)} is shown to be bounded (uniformly or with growth slower than \hbar_q^{-2n}), the tail decays as a geometric series.

Empirically (see the canonical formalism and the formal derivation) the per-level terms for \mathrm{D}, \mathrm{T}, \mathrm{^{3}He} satisfy |\hbar_q^{2n} \Delta^{(n)}| \leq |\hbar_q^{2(n-1)} \Delta^{(n-1)}| \cdot \hbar_q^2 to three significant figures, and the uniform_bound_pass flag in jet-tower-delta-max.witness.json is true for D, T, {}^{3}He across n = 1, \dots, 7 — consistent with \Delta^{(n)} being bounded (in fact roughly constant). Promoting that observation to a theorem closes the open subconjecture conj:jet-tower-uniform-delta-max.

Engineering consequence

Combined with the empirical level-1 residual \varepsilon^{(1)} = |\Delta^{(1)}| reported by the engine, the proposition gives a constructive error budget: once the within-level \hat{V} model is improved so \varepsilon^{(1)} is at the target precision, a single extra jet level gives O(\hbar_q^2) further reduction. The jet loop is therefore not the bottleneck for sub-ppm precision — the level-1 \hat{V} model is.

Relation to confinement SDP

The level-1 \hat V^{(1)} baseline entering this proposition is produced by the SDP-feasible confinement operator of prop:confinement-sdp. When the confinement SDP is at a rank-1 solution (scalar LP regime) the baseline \hat V is a real braid-word product and the boundedness hypothesis |\Delta^{(n)}| \le \Delta_{\max} holds empirically (cf. sdp-lift-audit.witness.json: every real Hecke word has x^T G x \ge 0). At higher ranks the hypothesis is open, and the jet-tail bound above remains conditional on the multi-operator binding supporting a uniform \Delta_{\max}. Closing that conditional is the main outstanding piece of open subconjecture 1 on rem:mass-endomorphism-jet-tower.

Formal asymptotic content. The geometric tail is the native Jackson d_q-difference of the brane tower; \ordw(\text{tail}) = 2(N+1)\,\ordw(\hbar_q), and the recursive jet prolongation is the surreal blow-up calculus. See Big-O via \ordw, calculus up to \varepsilon, and the body asymptotics catalog.
